stories.headline: Google Pay Adds Faster Checkout Tools for Android Apps
stories.body: Google now enables developers to enhance Android checkout by leveraging users’ stored credentials, including payment and address, from Google Wallet. The company has done so by bringing Express checkout with Google Pay for Android native apps, according to a Monday (May 26) blog post. stories.headline: Even JPMorgan Payments feels pressure to compete with fintechs
stories.body: JPMorgan Payments processes about $12 trillion in payments per day globally. It is also the largest credit card issuer and merchant acquirer in the country. But to stay on top, the banking behemoth has made it its business to work with, and think like, nimbler fintechs.
